info.title: Customer NF-e 55 screen — homologation only
info.description: Focus: XML obtido só pelos caminhos oficiais em homologação, sem redirecionamento. xml_archive_key_file é a chave privada de backup do cliente, 32 bytes, 0600, configuração local de confiança. Arquivo cifrado AES-GCM na outbox do banco escolhido, incluído no snapshot; guardar chave fora do backup. archive_state indica archived/pending/unavailable, sem alterar autorização. Consulta da mesma referência pode repetir GET de XML, nunca reemitir. Exportação é local e nunca consulta terceiros. Focus archive state is archived only after the encrypted customer-scoped row is actually persisted. An ignored write is a conflict/rollback and leaves archive_state=pending without discarding the authorized note; retry/query preserves its IDs and never implies another issuance. HTML/cupom rendering and PDF download tests do not approve physical printing or official Focus/SEFAZ acceptance. Model55 sale freight uses only the frozen complete pre-payment quote group: mode must match; item/total vFrete and total/payment reconcile. Other purposes and unbound charges refused. Sources: https://campos.focusnfe.com.br/nfe/NotaFiscalXML.html and https://campos.focusnfe.com.br/nfe/ItemNotaFiscalXML.html.

post.description: Owner only, active session and fiscal contract. Model 55, homologation only. Normal internal consumer sale with recorded cash or explicitly selected deferred method 21/91, without freight charges. Deferred choice preserves the AR origin and creates no receipt or cash movement. Query only consults; never resends. No recipient data in logs, telemetry or browser persistence. Items and taxes come from the recorded sale. Optional confirmed payment_code freezes an idempotent server-side selection before preparing the snapshot; only for an existing credit sale with matching AR installments and no sale payments. A changed method conflicts; {} reopens an already prepared snapshot. No issuance from preview.

get.description: Owner-only local archived homologation XML and CSV; UTC local-record period; missing documents explicit Before returning the artifact, the server revalidates the original session, tenant/store/device and view_accounting in the existing immediate SQLite writer, then persists audit.report_export in the local outbox: actor, period, artifact SHA-256 and scope IDs only. Ignored/failed audit writes release no artifact. This records an artifact prepared for response, not proof that a client received it. No financial posting, secret, customer name or document bytes enter that audit. Existing owner-only fiscal export authorization remains unchanged; accountant access to cash reports grants no fiscal-export privilege.

post.description: Owner-only, session and fiscal contract required. Homologation 55/A1 only. GET-only Focus consultation via the existing reference, and restricted XML download. Exact XML correction text must match the original server-side request SHA-256; no text, hash or private path is returned. Missing/mismatched XML or unreconciled sequence remains pending. No POST to Focus, no new sequence, no sale/payment/stock/cash change. Reconciliation status and encrypted XML use the existing database/backup and archive. A reconciliation result is acknowledged only when its journal row was persisted; an ignored write rolls back and leaves the original attempt pending, without another POST. Journal-only recovery remains idempotent. A result cannot prove official acceptance without the customer real homologation trial.
